entry.title: A userscript that adds a table of contents to any website
entry.content: auto-toc auto-tocDisplays a table of contents for any website, making it easier to read and navigate long articles, documentations, and online books. Generate TOC(table of contents) for any website. Switch black/white themes automatically according to your compupter’s light/dark mode. Features Work properly on any website that conforms to the HTML standard and uses HTML heading tags properly (e.g. Wikipedia.com). Accurate article and heading detection A clean user interface Highlight current heading Click to jump to headings Drag the panel to your preferred position Only runs when you actually use it Dark mode, automatically 6 heading levels Expand all headings to a specific level Support HTML label: H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6 <strong> <b> . . . Installation & Usage English: https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/458022-auto-toc?locale_override=1 By default, it is not open. You need to go to the plug-in menu to open the switch for the website that wants to open the toc. The plug-in will remember this switch, and the toc will be generated automatically according to the switch when you open the website the next time. Inspired by https://github.com/FallenMax/smart-toc https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/lifgeihcfpkmmlfjbailfpfhbahhibba https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/415856-bc-smarttoc

entry.title: A shell plugin that provides interactive Tab search & completion for any path
entry.content: tab-to-find tab-to-findOne tab enables interactive and dynamic search for everything!! It also supports tab dynamic completion of commands for the paths of any directories and files. It is extremely useful for people who often need to find files and are troubled by entering very long paths. There is no need to type the paths one by one slowly. You can search and reach the target in one step. Even if there are millions of files, it is still very smooth and not laggy at all. Abbreviation: TTF Demo features Just press tab as usual. Without entering anything, tab can directly and dynamically search for all directories and files in the current directory and its subdirectories. It’s also very useful just as a search tool. Use tab to autocomplete. It doesn’t necessarily have to be an exact match at the beginning. For example, if you enter doc and then press tab, it can match test_doc, doc_test, and test_doc_test. It can recursively match all files/directories with doc in the subdirectories of the current directory. That means you can enter cd doc in the home directory and directly cd from the home directory to ~/github/test - proj/documents in one step! If there is only one match, it will be automatically completed. For example, if it matches Documents/, but if that’s not what you want and you want ~/github/test - proj/documents, you can press tab again. If there is more than one match, it will recursively search all folders containing doc in the subdirectories. If what follows cd is not a directory, it will automatically enter the directory where that file is located. For example, if you enter cd ~/github/test.txt, it can directly enter the ~/github folder. If the input ends with //, it can search only for folders in one level of the directory, instead of recursively searching all subdirectories. If the input ends with .., it can search only for files in one level of the directory, instead of recursively searching all subdirectories. The same applies to other commands such as vi, ln, mv, cp, etc. Usage Press tab to search everything Press tab for completion as usual . . . 安装方法 先安装fd, 按照 fd的安装方法 安装一下就行(一般来说就是一行命令就搞定), 不用额外配置 再安装fzf, 按照 fzf的安装方法 安装一下就行(一般来说就是一行命令就搞定), 不用额外配置 然后再按照下方的手动方式 或者 走Oh-My-Zsh方式的方式来安装 tab-to-find 就可以了 手动方式先克隆一波这个项目 git clone https://github.com/no5ix/tab-to-find ~/somewhere 然后把下面这行加到你的 ~/.zshrc. source ~/somewhere/tab-to-find.plugin.zsh OhMyZsh方式执行下面这行命令 git clone https://github.com/no5ix/tab-to-find ${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/tab-to-find 然后vim ~/.zshrc, 找到七八十行左右 plugins=(git) 的位置 比如原来是 plugins=(git) 则改为 plugins=(git tab-to-find) source ~/.zshrc 或者重启 zsh Installation Install fd by following its installation instruction. Install fzf by following its installation instruction. then install tab-to-find by following Manual or Oh-My-Zsh below Manualclone this repository. git clone https://github.com/no5ix/tab-to-find ~/somewhere Then add the following line to your ~/.zshrc. source ~/somewhere/tab-to-find.plugin.zsh OhMyZshClone this repository to your custom directory and then add tab-to-find to your plugin list. git clone https://github.com/no5ix/tab-to-find ${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/tab-to-find

entry.title: Mac Notes
entry.content: 笔记介绍这是一份 mac 折腾配置以及各种改造的精华笔记, 可以帮你从头到尾打造一个极为顺手的 mac. 在Windows端配合sux 可以统一 win & mac 的使用体验. . . . 改键Karabiner(已经用hammerspoon完全替代)改键软件 Karabiner-Elements 的配置得直接覆盖他的配置文件 karabiner.json (它的配置文件路径在 app 里的 misc 里有),弄完之后记得去mac的设置-Keyboard-Keyboard Shortcuts-Input Sources-Select next source in Input menu里更改快捷键为ctrl+option+space 参考: https://github.com/pqrs-org/Karabiner-Elements/issues/2711 https://github.com/pqrs-org/Karabiner-Elements/issues/2949 https://github.com/pqrs-org/KE-complex_modifications/issues/697#issuecomment-678677912 https://github.com/realliyifei/mac-karabiner-chinese-punctuations-to-halfwidth-forms Mac读写NTFS格式移动硬盘(使用NTFS Disk by Omi也可以, 但是buhoNTFS更好因为免费)打开mac自带的Disk Utility这个软件 , 右键选中你的 USB 磁盘，记住这个页面的表格中的右下角的Device是啥(这个就是你的 NTFS 磁盘标识符, 一般叫做类似于disk2s1的名字), 然后点击 “Unmount”, 打开 terminal , 然后在里面输入下面的命令 (记住要把里面的”disk2s1” 换成你的NTFS磁盘的标识符, ): Diskutil list Sudo mkdir /Volumes/disk2s1 Sudo mount -t ntfs -o rw,auto,nobrowse /dev/disk2s1 /Volumes/disk2s1 sudo ln -s /Volumes/disk2s1 ~/Desktop/disk2s1 这是在桌面创建了一个软链接即快捷方式。但是这个软链接不管是否硬盘都会一直留在桌面，不介意的可以到此结束了。那么如何将这个桌面上的磁盘隐藏掉了呢？其实也不是隐藏，只是换了个存在的地方 —— 将快捷方式拖入 Finder 的侧边栏即可。 科学上网科学上网软件： ClashX下载地址: https://itlanyan.com/trojan-clients-download/ 步骤: 去 just my socks 拷贝那些服务节点的配置然后去google搜“ss配置转clash配置”的网站(但是似乎很有可能会泄露相关 ss 密码之类的)，比如 https://subconverter.speedupvpn.com ， 然后在线转换为clash的配置然后点击 ClashX 的菜单栏的图标， 然后 Config-Remote Config-Manage-Add 如果发现上不了网的话, 点击 ClashX 的图标, 然后 Config-Open Config Folder 查看生成的 config 文件是否和 本 github 项目的 clashx里的类似 请不要打开 clashx 的”设置为系统代理”, 否则剪映等一些软件无法联网, 但此时 safari 也会翻不了墙 (以下教程参考 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pAY8pNou9Gk) 此时需要先把 safari_proxy 文件夹中的 proxy.pac(这个是由 edge 的 SwitchyOmega插件里的配置生成的) 放到 /Library/WebServer/Documents 里 然后在设置-网络-高级-代理的Automatic proxy configuration 里输入 http://127.0.0.1/proxy.pac, 然后点击 右下角的 ok, 点击完ok之后会退回上一层菜单, 然后再点击 Apply 然后在 terminal 里输入命令 sudo apachectl start 去 safari 的地址栏输入http://127.0.0.1/proxy.pac 测试一下是否能访问这个, 有内容说明成功了, 此时再看看是否能谷歌/油管 此时还有个问题就是:可能会因为其它软件给关掉，如 ClashX 设置为系统代理的时候会把这个 pac 给清除掉, 所以我们需要检查一下 hammerspoon 里的 init.lua是否有 networksetup -setautoproxyurl 相关的代码, 有的话就会自动在激活 safari 的时候自动设置一下 pac 设置(相关代码其实是参考了 https://nowtime.cc/macos/1753.html , networksetup -setautoproxyurl "Wi-Fi" "http://127.0.0.1/proxy.pac" , 这个 “Wi-Fi” 是通过命令 networksetup -listallnetworkservices 拿到的) 触摸板增强软件： betterTouchTool破解版的得把下面这几句加到clashx当前所用的config文件的rules里来屏蔽下面这些地址- DOMAIN-KEYWORD,folivora.ai,REJECT- DOMAIN-KEYWORD,www.folivora.ai,REJECT- DOMAIN-KEYWORD,updates.boastr.net,REJECT- DOMAIN-KEYWORD,updates.folivora.ai,REJECT 加完之后去浏览器测试一下是否能打开这几个网址， 打不开则为屏蔽成功，然后再打开betterTouchTool。 jetbrain-crack用jetbrain_crack 文件夹里 的 ja-netfilter, 然后参考下方链接来破解即可, 适用于 jb2022.1 的全家桶 https://learnku.com/articles/67432 https://segmentfault.com/a/1190000041769901 clion使用的时候切记: 要把项目目录以及各种觉得要mark的目录右键Mark directory as一下, 然后再项目根目录Reload Cmake Project 搜狗输入法皮肤自己做了仨, 黑白灰 另外的好东西高仿 mac风格: Rime 鼠须管输入法皮肤效果 https://ssnhd.com/2022/01/11/rime-skin/ Alfred 配置: 把 Alfred.alfredpreferences 直接复制到 Alfred的配置文件夹(即 Advance-Reveal in Finder 出来的文件夹) 里覆盖即可 皮肤: 自己做了俩, 对应黑夜白天 配置中的 workflow 相关网址: https://github.com/zqzten/alfred-web-search-suggest https://github.com/iamstevendao/alfred-open-with-vscode https://github.com/LeEnno/alfred-terminalfinder https://github.com/wensonsmith/YoudaoTranslator hammerspoon装好 hammerspoon 之后, 把~下的.hammerspoon文件夹里的删除, 然后将本项目中的 hammerspoon 文件夹的内容放到 ~下的.hammerspoon文件夹里 禁止cleanmymacx即使退出它的HealthMonitor还一直后台运行(App Cleaner & Uninstaller更好用)问题：虽然CleanMyMacX软件被吹嘘的很厉害，在用起来感觉也可以帮助更好的清理电脑，但是它一直后台运行，还终止不了，一直监控Mac的信息情况，个人觉得很是鸡肋，在使用的时候打开用就行了，平常没必要一直常驻，对于内存紧张的朋友来说太吃内存了。 经过试验，可以修改权限解决，不需要删除文件，也不会出现system.log中的异常日志。 解决办法： 打开终端输入以下 chmod 400 "/Applications/CleanMyMac X.app/Contents/Library/LoginItems/CleanMyMac X Menu.app/Contents/Library/LoginItems/CleanMyMac X HealthMonitor.app/Contents/MacOS/CleanMyMac X HealthMonitor" chmod 400 "/Applications/CleanMyMac X.app/Contents/Library/LoginItems/CleanMyMac X Menu.app/Contents/Library/LaunchServices/com.macpaw.CleanMyMac4.Agent" chmod 400 "/Applications/CleanMyMac X.app/Contents/Library/LaunchServices/com.macpaw.CleanMyMac4.Agent" 然后去活动监视器终止CleanMyMacX所有进程即可。 启动台行列【终端】输入或粘贴以下命令，修改后面的数字更改行列数。 行数 defaults write com.apple.dock springboard-rows -int 9 列数 defaults write com.apple.dock springboard-columns -int 10 最后输入以下命令 killall Dock 程序坞降低显示延迟如果你习惯隐藏程序坞，鼠标放在屏幕底部，默认显示程序坞非常慢，你可以在【终端】输入或粘贴下面命令，将数值改为 0，这样，显示程序坞会变的很快。 defaults write com.apple.dock autohide-delay -int 0 最后输入以下命令 killall Dock 允许任何来源安装非 App Store 里应用，可能会出现无法安装的情况，需要打开任何来源。【终端】输入或粘贴以下命令，按回车键。 sudo spctl --master-disable 密码位数管理员默认密码至少为 4 位，【终端】输入或粘贴以下命令支持将密码改为 1 位。 pwpolicy -clearaccountpolicies 深色主题显示浅色窗口程序坞和菜单栏深色，窗口是浅色。 【终端】输入或粘贴以下命令，按回车键, 注销并重新登录 Mac, 系统偏好设置 - 通用 - 深色。defaults write -g NSRequiresAquaSystemAppearance -bool Yes 恢复原样: defaults delete -g NSRequiresAquaSystemAppearance Mac 删除原生 ABC 英文输入法(macos14.0实测已经失效)删除系统英文 ABC，只保留一个输入法，这样搜狗输入法只需按 Shift 即可切换中英文。 (这一步可以不做, 因为 sip 关闭之后 iOS 程序在 mac 就不能运行了, 所以先不做等发现删不掉 abc再来做吧, 关闭 sip 之后删除 abc 输入法再打开sip也可以 )先关闭 系统完整性保护SIP, 参考 系统完整性保护SIP 前往自己home 目录下的 ~/Library/Preferences/ 文件夹，找到 com.apple.HIToolbox.plist 文件, 先备份 cp com.apple.HIToolbox.plist com.apple.HIToolbox.plist.bak 删除 AppleEnabledInputSources 下的 <dict> <key>InputSourceKind</key> <string>Keyboard Layout</string> <key>KeyboardLayout ID</key> <integer>252</integer> <key>KeyboardLayout Name</key> <string>ABC</string></dict> 然后保存 重启 Mac。 恢复原样: 不必担心此操作给电脑带来异常，一切正常。还原打开系统偏好设置 → 键盘 → 输入法 → 添加 ABC 即可。 terminal相关install oh-my-zshsh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)" install powerlevel10k主题 & 路径颜色改色改成紫色install p10k: git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k.git "${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/themes/powerlevel10k" Open ~/.zshrc, find the line that sets ZSH_THEME, and change its value to "powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k" (optional)不改色的话, 默认是蓝色太亮看不清又伤眼 vim ~/.p10k.zsh 找到 POWERLEVEL9K_DIR_BACKGROUND 然后改成 typeset -g POWERLEVEL9K_DIR_BACKGROUND=128 保存 source ~/.p10k.zsh fzf-安装与配置 安装 fd (fd 使用 brew install fd命令来安装) 用 brew 安装: brew install fzf put the fzf-conf-code below to ~/.zshrc, 然后 vim ~/.zshrc, 找到七八十行左右 plugins=(git)的位置 比如原来是 plugins=(git) 则改为 plugins=(git tab-to-find), source ~/.zshrc 或者重启 zsh then you can use option+f to search current directory command history; option+r to search global command history; fzf-conf-code# ==========================================# fzf history configuration# ==========================================# Keep global history search available through fzf's built-in widget.# Option+R: global command historybindkey '^[r' fzf-history-widget# Option+F: commands previously run from the current working directory.# Commands are recorded in separate files, one per exact directory path._FZF_DIR_HISTORY="$HOME/.zsh_directory_history"mkdir -p "$_FZF_DIR_HISTORY"_fzf_record_dir_history() { # preexec receives the command line about to be executed as $1. # Store each command as one history entry. Multiline commands are not # reliably represented by this simple line-oriented log. local dir_hash dir_hash=$(printf '%s' "$PWD" | shasum | cut -c1-16) || return print -r -- "$1" >> "$_FZF_DIR_HISTORY/$dir_hash"}# Avoid registering the same hook more than once if ~/.zshrc is sourced again.autoload -Uz add-zsh-hookadd-zsh-hook -d preexec _fzf_record_dir_history 2>/dev/nulladd-zsh-hook preexec _fzf_record_dir_historyfzf-history-current-directory() { local dir_hash history_file selected dir_hash=$(printf '%s' "$PWD" | shasum | cut -c1-16) || return history_file="$_FZF_DIR_HISTORY/$dir_hash" if [[ ! -s "$history_file" ]]; then zle -M "No command history recorded for this directory yet" return fi selected=$(fzf --no-sort --tac --query="$LBUFFER" < "$history_file") if [[ -n "$selected" ]]; then LBUFFER="$selected" RBUFFER="" fi zle redisplay}zle -N fzf-history-current-directorybindkey '^[e' fzf-history-current-directory

entry.title: W Restaurant Interview Notes
entry.content: hexo s… 自我介绍 & 面试 Hello, my name is . It’s nice to meet you.你好，我叫，很高兴见到您。 I am hardworking and I learn fast.我勤奋并且学习能力很快。 I enjoy working with people and giving good service.我喜欢和人打交道并提供优质服务。 I don’t have direct waiter experience, but I am a quick learner.我没有直接的服务员经验，但我学习很快。 I’m confident I can do this job well.我相信自己能胜任这份工作。 迎宾 & 点单 Welcome! How many people?欢迎光临！请问几位？ Do you have a reservation?请问您有预订吗？ Please follow me. Here is your table.请跟我来。这是您的餐桌。 Here are the menus. May I take your drink order first?这是菜单，请问需要先点饮料吗？ Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?您准备好点菜了吗，还是需要再等几分钟？ Our special today is .我们今天的特色菜是。 How would you like your steak cooked? (rare, medium, well-done)您要几分熟的牛排？（生的，五分，或全熟） Would you like soup or salad with that?这道菜要配汤还是沙拉？ Anything else for you?还需要别的吗？ I’ll be right back with your order.我马上帮您下单。 上菜 & 用餐中 Here is your , enjoy your meal.这是您的，祝您用餐愉快。 Can I get you anything else?还需要我帮您拿点什么吗？ How is everything?一切都还满意吗？ I’ll refill your water.我帮您续一下水。 Please be careful, the plate is hot.请小心，盘子很烫。 结账 & 道别 Would you like dessert or coffee?您要甜点或咖啡吗？ Here is the check. Would you like one check or separate checks?这是账单，您要一起算还是分开算？ I’ll take care of that for you now.我马上帮您处理。 Thank you very much for coming.非常感谢您的光临。 Have a great day!祝您今天愉快！ 处理问题 I’m sorry about the wait. I’ll check with the kitchen.很抱歉久等了，我去厨房确认一下。 I apologize for the mistake. Let me fix it now.抱歉出错了，我马上帮您纠正。 Let me bring the manager for you.我帮您请经理过来。 Thank you for your patience.感谢您的耐心等待。 We’ll take care of it now.我们会马上处理。

entry.title: W Easy English-061-A Trip to London
entry.content: 061-A Trip to London It’s been really long since we all have taken a trip together. Let’s plan something for this summer. Let’s go to Miami Beach. The beaches are world class(世界级的：在某一领域中属于世界上最好的类型之一). You can eat the most scrumptious (/ˈskrʌmpʃəs/adj. 美味的；绝妙的，极好的)Latin American cuisine(/kwɪˈziːn/n. 烹饪，风味；饭菜，菜肴) every night of the week. The weather is perfect. There are many hiking and biking trails(/treɪlz/n. 山径；踪迹（trail 的复数）；游径). And we can have so many adventures (/ədˈventʃər/n. 冒险（经历），奇遇) like canoeing(/kəˈnuːɪŋ/n. 玩独木舟，划独木舟;v. 乘独木舟（canoe 的 ing 形式）), snorkeling(/ˈsnɔːrkəlɪŋ/n. 浮潜；潜水；浅滩潜水v. 用水下通气管潜航；用通气管潜泳（snorkel 的 ing 形式）) or scuba diving(/ˈskuːbə daɪvɪŋ/水肺潜水；轻便（潜水器）潜水). Phillip, we’ve already been there twice. Let’s try something different this time. I would like to go abroad, preferably(/ˈprefrəbli/adv. 更合意地，最好是) to Europe. How about Italy? It has spectacular(/spekˈtækjələr/adj. 壮观的，令人惊叹的；惊人的，突如其来的) cities, ancient ruins(/ˈeɪnʃənt ˈruːɪnz/古代遗址：指古代文明或历史时期的建筑物、城市或其他遗迹的残骸或遗址。), wonderful museums, great beaches and beautiful natural scenery(/ˈsiːnəri/n. 风景，景色；舞台布景). Let’s better go to England and visit London. We’ve never been there. There’s lots to do in London and people go there from all over the world. We can have an ace(/eɪs/adj. <非正式>一流的；<非正式>极好的) time. That’s a great idea. There are many great places to visit in London. There are fine museums, magnificent(/mæɡˈnɪfɪs(ə)nt/adj. 宏伟的，壮丽的) palaces, superb(/suːˈpɜːrb/adj. 极佳的，质量极高的) royal(/ˈrɔɪəl/adj. 王室的；皇家的 ) parks, trendy(/ˈtrendi/adj. 时髦的) shopping districts(/ˈdɪstrɪkts/n. 区域；地域（district 的复数形式）), and wonderful entertainment(/ˌentərˈteɪnmənt/n. 娱乐，娱乐表演) venues(/ˈvenjuː/场所). That’s going to be the best trip ever. What do you say, Philip? It sounds interesting. Let’s do it. Perfect. I will book the flight tickets and hotel. Hello, I’m Lillian Miller. What can I do for you? Hello. I’d like to book a direct flight to London, please. When do you plan to travel? On July 15th. Would you like a one-way or round trip ticket? Round trip ticket, we’re coming back on the 23rd. Let me check what flights are available in this period(/ˈpɪriəd/n. 时期). Would you like a morning, an afternoon, or an evening flight? I’d like an evening flight, please. Which class do you prefer? Economy, business, or a first class? Economy. How many seats would you like? Four seats, I’ll travel with my family. There is a direct flight to London with British Airways, United Airlines, or with Delta(达美航空). Which airline would you prefer? Which one is cheapest? Delta flight is the cheapest. One ticket costs $475, so four tickets are $1,900. Then I would choose Delta. How long does the flight take? The total time is eight hours and 17 minutes. Can I have your name? My name is Jonathan Stewart. Here’s my identity card. Can you also recommend(/ˌrekəˈmend/v. 推荐，介绍) a cheap hotel in London? We would like to stay for seven nights? The Chamberlain is a comfortable hotel with easy access(/ˈækses/进入) to central attractions(名胜古迹). How many rooms would you like to reserve(/rɪˈzɜːrv/v. 预订)? The two rooms, one double(双人房,大床房) and one twin(双床房,标间), please. We can offer you one standard(/ˈstændərd/adj. 普通的，标准的) twin for $80 and one standard double room for the same price. What’s included in this cost? A full buffet(/bəˈfeɪ/n. 自助餐) breakfast, free Wi-Fi and room service. Okay, that’s settled(/ˈsetld/ 那就这么定了), I’ll take it. 04:27 In London We’re finally in London. How exciting! Yes, we’ve made it(取得成功) here safely. What are we going to do first? First, we need to exchange some money. We need some local cash for a taxi to the hotel. Okay, let’s go find an exchange office. I don’t think that’s a good idea. The exchange rate(/reɪt/比率) is really high in the airport and so are the fees.(so am I我也一样) The most economical(/ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk(ə)l/adj. 经济实惠的；节约的；简练的) way to obtain(/əbˈteɪn/得到,获得) British(/ˈbrɪtɪʃ/) pounds is to use our ATM card. Okay. Excuse me, do you happen to(happen to 碰巧/恰巧 )know where an ATM is in this area? It’s at the end of the corridor(/ˈkɔːrɪdɔːr/n. （建筑物或火车内的）通道，过道) near the gate door and men’s washroom. It’s right in the corner. Thanks a lot. You’re welcome. 00:05:29 - would you like a cab Hello, would you like a cab(/kæb/出租车,的士)? Yes, we would. Where would you like to go? To the Chamber Lane Hotel, do you know where it is? I certainly do. It’s a popular hotel. I’ll take you there right away(right away = “马上就做（但可准备一下）” right now = “立刻、马上、现在此刻！”). Please put your luggage in the boot(/buːt/n. 靴子（汽车的）后备箱) of the car. Boot? Oh, you mean the trunk(/trʌŋk/n. 树干（汽车后部的）行李箱，后备箱)? Exactly, we call it boot in the UK. Are you here on holiday? Holiday, you mean vacation? Yes. That’s right, we’re here on vacation. This is our first time here. Well, welcome to our city. It’s a really nice time and for the year to visit. There’s lots to see and do. I really recommend(/ˌrekəˈmend/推荐) checking out(check out 在这里是“去看看、去逛逛”的意- 思（口语）)Oxford Street. It’s a popular shopping area. Oh, that sounds interesting. We do need to do some shopping, thanks for the tip.We do need：我们确实需要（“do” 在这里是强调语气）👉 表示“真的需要”或“的确需要”。例如：I do like this city. → 我真的喜欢这座城市。to do some shopping：去买些东西 / 去购物 How long are you staying, may I ask? We’ll be here for a week, so we should have plenty of time to see the most popular - attractions(/əˈtrækʃ(ə)n/n. 有吸引力的事物). Okay, here we are, it’s 20 pounds. Here you go. Thanks and enjoy your stay. 06:57 Good morning, how can I help you? Good morning, we have a reservation under the name of Stewart.(under the name of - …：以……的名字（登记 / 预订）) Let me check. Yes, Stewart. A double room and a twin room for seven nights, bed and breakfast. Is that right? That’s correct. Could I see some ID please? A passport or an identity(/aɪˈdentəti/身份) card? Here you go. Would you please fill in(/fɪl ɪn/填写或补充) this registration(/ˌredʒɪˈstreɪʃ(ə)n/n. - 登记，注册) form, sir? Sure. What’s your favourite place in London if you don’t mind? Oh, it’s Covent Garden. It’s one of the best areas in London. There are many restaurants, alleys(/ˈæli/n. 小巷，胡同) to explore(/ɪkˈsplɔːr/v. 探- 索) and the best things to do. How do we get there? You can take a cab or use the tube(/tuːb/<英，非正式>乘地铁). Taxis are pretty expensive in London, so we’d better take the subway. Is the subway station far away from here? As soon as(As soon as：一……就……) you get out of the hotel, turn right. Go straight - ahead for five minutes. Then you’ll see the underground station. You can’t miss it.(你不会错过它（意思是“很容易看到”、“一定能找到”）) Okay, thanks a lot. I’m done. Here’s the form. Thank you. Your room includes breakfast in the morning. Breakfast is served between 7.30am and 10am in the restaurant in front of the - reception(/rɪˈsepʃ(ə)n/n. 接待处,服务台). On the last morning of your stay, you have to check out before 11am. Here’s your key. It’s room 406 on the fourth floor. Anything you need, please don’t hesitate(/ˈhezɪteɪt/v. 犹豫，不愿意) to call our desk for help. Enjoy your stay. Thank you. Where is the elevator? The lift is right there near the stairs.right there 就在那里：表示某物或某人就在说话人所指的位置或附近。 When you get off the lift, turn right. Your room is at the end of the corridor on the left-hand side. Do you need help with your bags? No, it’s okay, thanks. 09:26 What are we going to do today? How about going to Covent Garden? What’s that? It’s London’s main theatre(/ˈθiːətər/n. 剧场，戏院) and entertainment(/ˌentərˈteɪnmənt/n. 娱乐) area. Are there markets too? Yes, there are many markets and souvenir(/ˌsuːvəˈnɪr/n. 纪念品，纪念物) shops. Are there restaurants too? I’m really hungry. Yes, there are some of the best restaurants in London. What are we waiting for then? Let’s go. 09:57 Hello, I’m Harry. I’ll be your waiter today. What can I get you to drink? I’ll have a lemonade, please. Me too. I’ll have a Coke. And I’ll have a ginger beer.ginger beer 姜啤/姜汁汽水：一种加入姜或辣椒或两者都有的甜味碳酸非酒精饮料。 Okay, I’ll be right back with your drinks. Are you ready to order? Yes, we are. I’ll have a Caesar salad and what’s an Alfredo sauce?Caesar/ˈsiːzər/ salad：凯撒沙拉what’s an Alfredo sauce?：阿尔弗雷多酱是什么？ A cream sauce, very rich(浓郁), very good. Oh, yummy. I’ll try that. I’ll try the house salad and the meatballs and spaghetti(/spəˈɡeti/n. 意大利式细面条). I’m gonna have the steak(/steɪk/) medium and the soup to start. What will you have, Philip? I’m gonna go for the cheese bomb burger and fries.✅ 为什么用 go for？go for 是英语口语里非常常见的一个短语，意思是：选择、决定要、挑……（特别是点餐或做选择时）它比 “choose” 更口语、更自然。✅ “go for” 的常见表达：I’ll go for the chicken.我选鸡肉。I think I’ll go for the blue one.我觉得我会选蓝色的那个。I’m gonna go for the salad.我打算选沙拉。✅ 为什么不用 choose？“choose” 太正式、不像说话。在餐厅里，点餐时最自然的表达方式是：I’ll have…I’ll go for…I’m gonna get… It’s so hard today. I’d like to eat an ice cream. Look, there’s an ice cream stand over there.✅ “stand over there” 的意思stand：这里不是“站立”，而是指 小摊、摊位、卖东西的小亭子（如：hot dog stand 热狗摊）over there：在那边，表示一个相对较远但能看到的位置 Let’s go. Hi, how can I help you? Hi. What flavors of ice cream do you have? We have all the basic flavors like chocolate, vanilla, coconut, banana and many more. Do you have strawberry ice cream? Yes, we do. How many scoops would you like? I’d like one large scoop of strawberry and one small scoop of chocolate. Would you like any toppings? Yes, I’d like chocolate sauce, please. Will that be all? Yes. Okay, that will be five pounds. Here you go. Thank you. What would you like to have? I would like three small scoops of strawberry, chocolate and vanilla ice cream with sprinkles, please. That will be five pounds. Thank you. I love Covent Garden. There’s something magical about it. It’s so colorful and it’s full of great places to eat and shop. The street performers and musicians are really talented, aren’t they? Yes, they are. It’s such a lovely atmosphere here. There are so many nice things in the souvenir market. Wow, look at this garden. It’s so cute. Excuse me, how much is this doll? It’s 20 pounds. I love it. Can I buy it, Mom? Of course. And how much are those mugs with the British flag? The big mugs are 10.25 and the small ones are 8.75. Can I have two big mugs and one guard doll? Here you are. Anything else? How much is that white t-shirt over there? It’s 15 pounds. Do you have it in large size? Yes, of course. Here you are. What about this key chain with the London Underground logo? How much is it? That’s two pounds. Can I buy this for Grandpa? Sure, I think you would love it. And this t-shirt is for Grandma. Will that be all? Yes, that’s all. It’s getting pretty late and I’m so tired. I think we should go back to the hotel. I think so too. I wonder where the subway station is. Excuse me, how do we get to the Underground station from here? Ah, it’s easy. Going on this street and turn right into Southampton Road. OK, so turn right into Southampton Road. Yeah, then go along Southampton Road and go through Covent Garden Market. After that, go along James Street, Pass Floral Street. You’ll see the station on the left. How far away is it? It will take you about 10 minutes. Thank you very much. Don’t mention it. Good morning. How can I help you? Good morning. We’d like to book a bus tour for today. We’d like to see the top London landmarks. I recommend you our Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour. This tour lets you jump on and off so you can visit attractions, have lunch or go shopping, could see famous attractions like Buckingham Palace, famous Piccadilly Circus, the Tower of London, the Faga Square, Big Ben and many more. That seems to be exactly what we need. How long does it take? The whole route takes about two hours and the bus departs from Waterloo. And how much are the tickets? One ticket is 35 pounds and you can buy it from the driver. There is a discount for a family ticket which includes two adults and two children. That sounds good. Is there a guide on the bus? Yes, there is a live guide who gives you information about the place as your visit. That sounds amazing. We’re going to have a blast today. 伦敦之旅 (A Trip to London)061-A Trip to London061-伦敦之旅It’s been really long since we all have taken a trip together.我们大家一起旅行已经是很久以前的事了。Let’s plan something for this summer.我们来计划一下今年夏天去哪里吧。Let’s go to Miami Beach.我们去迈阿密海滩吧。The beach is a world class(世界级的：在某一领域中属于世界上最好的类型之一).那里的海滩是世界级的。You can eat the most scrumptious (/ˈskrʌmpʃəs/adj. 美味的；绝妙的，极好的) Latin American cuisine(/kwɪˈziːn/n. 烹饪，风味；饭菜，菜肴) every night of the week.每周每晚你都能吃到最美味（绝妙的）拉丁美洲菜肴。The weather is perfect.天气也很完美。There are many hiking and biking trails(/treɪls/n. 山径；踪迹（trail 的复数）；游径).那里有许多徒步和骑自行车的山径。And we can have so many adventures (/ədˈventʃər/n. 冒险（经历），奇遇) like canoeing(/kəˈnuːɪŋ/n. 玩独木舟，划独木舟;v. 乘独木舟（canoe 的 ing 形式）), snorkeling(/ˈsnɔːrkəlɪŋ/n. 浮潜；潜水；浅滩潜水v. 用水下通气管潜航；用通气管潜泳（snorkel 的 ing 形式）) or scuba diving(/ˈskuːbə daɪvɪŋ/水肺潜水；轻便（潜水器）潜水).而且我们可以进行很多冒险活动，比如划独木舟、浮潜或水肺潜水。Phillip have we’ve already been there twice.菲利普，我们已经去过那里两次了。Let’s try something different this time.这次我们试试去点不一样的地方吧。I would like to go abroad, preferably(/ˈprefrəbli/adv. 更合意地，最好是) to Europe.我想去国外，最好是欧洲。How about Italy?意大利怎么样？It has spectacular(/spekˈtækjələr/adj. 壮观的，令人惊叹的；惊人的，突如其来的) cities, ancient ruins(/ˈeɪnʃənt ˈruːɪnz/古代遗址：指古代文明或历史时期的建筑物、城市或其他遗迹的残骸或遗址。), wonderful museums, great beaches and beautiful natural scenery(/ˈsiːnəri/n. 风景，景色；舞台布景).它有壮观的城市、古代遗址、很棒的博物馆、美丽的海滩和优美的自然风光。Let’s better go to England and visit London.我们不如去英格兰，参观伦敦吧。We’ve never been there.我们从未去过那里。There’s lots to do in London and people go there from all over the world.伦敦有很多可玩可做的事情，而且全世界的人都会去那里。We can have an ace(/eɪs/adj. <非正式>一流的；<非正式>极好的) time.我们一定会玩得非常开心（极好的时光）。That’s a great idea.那是个好主意。There are many great places to visit in London.伦敦有许多很棒的景点。There are fine museums, magnificent(/mæɡˈnɪfɪs(ə)nt/adj. 宏伟的，壮丽的) palaces, superb(/suːˈpɜːrb/adj. 极佳的，质量极高的) royal(/ˈrɔɪəl/adj. 王室的；皇家的 ) parks, trendy(/ˈtrendi/adj. 时髦的) shopping districts(/ˈdɪstrɪkts/n. 区域；地域（district 的复数形式）), and wonderful entertainment(/ˌentərˈteɪnmənt/n. 娱乐，娱乐表演) venues(/ˈvenjuː/场所).那里有精致的博物馆、宏伟的宫殿、一流的皇家公园、时尚的购物区和精彩的娱乐场所。It’s going to be the best trip ever.这将是有史以来最棒的旅行。What do you say, Philip?你觉得怎么样，菲利普？It sounds interesting.听起来很有趣。Let’s do it.那就这么定了。Perfect.太好了。I will book the flight tickets and hotel.我来预订机票和酒店。 Hello, I’m Lillian Miller.您好，我是莉莉安·米勒。What can I do for you?有什么可以帮您的吗？Hello.您好。I’d like to book a direct flight to London, please.我想预订一张直飞伦敦的机票。When do you plan to travel?您计划什么时候出行？On July 15th.7月15日。Would you like a one-way or round trip ticket?您想要单程票还是往返票？Round trip ticket, we’re coming back on the 23rd.往返票，我们23号回来。Let me check what flights are available in this period(/ˈpɪriəd/n. 时期).我查一下这段时期有哪些可用的航班。Would you like a morning, an afternoon, or an evening flight?您想要上午、下午还是晚上的航班？I’d like an evening flight, please.我想要晚上的航班。Which class do you prefer?您偏好哪个舱位？Economy, business, or a first class?经济舱、商务舱还是头等舱？Economy.经济舱。How many seats would you like?您需要多少个座位？Four seats, I’ll travel with my family.四个座位，我将和我的家人一起旅行。There is a direct flight to London with British Airways, United Airlines, or with Delta(达美航空).有英国航空、联合航空和达美航空的直飞伦敦航班。Which airline would you prefer?您倾向于选择哪家航空公司？Which one is cheapest?哪一个最便宜？Delta flight is the cheapest.达美航空的航班最便宜。One ticket costs $475, so four tickets are $1,900.一张票是475美元，所以四张票一共是1900美元。Then I would choose Delta.那我选择达美航空。How long does the flight take?这次飞行需要多长时间？The total time is eight hours and 17 minutes.总共时长是8小时17分钟。Can I have your name?能告诉我您的名字吗？My name is Jonathan Stewart.我的名字是乔纳森·斯图尔特。Here’s my identity card.这是我的身份证。Can you also recommend(/ˌrekəˈmend/v. 推荐，介绍) a cheap hotel in London?您能推荐一家伦敦便宜的酒店吗？We would like to stay for seven nights?我们想住七晚。The Chamberlain is a comfortable hotel with easy access(/ˈækses/进入) to central attractions(名胜古迹).张伯伦酒店（The Chamberlain）是一家舒适的酒店，交通便利，方便前往市中心景点。How many rooms would you like to reserve(/rɪˈzɜːrv/v. 预订)?您想预订多少间房？The two rooms, one double(双人房,大床房) and one twin(双床房,标间), please.请给我们两间房，一间双人房（大床房）和一间双床房（标间）。We can offer you one standard(/ˈstændərd/adj. 普通的，标准的) twin for $80 and one standard double room for the same price.我们可以为您提供一间标准双床房，价格是80美元，一间标准双人房也是同样的价格。What’s included in this cost?这个费用都包括什么？A full buffet(/bəˈfeɪ/n. 自助餐) breakfast, free Wi-Fi room service.包括丰盛的自助早餐、免费Wi-Fi和客房服务。Okay, that’s settled(/ˈsetld/ 那就这么定了), I’ll take it.好的，那就这么定了，我订了。 We’re finally in London.我们终于到伦敦了。How exciting!太激动人心了！Yes, we’ve made it(取得成功) here safely.是的，我们安全到达了。What are we going to do first?我们第一件要做的事是什么？First, we need to exchange some money.首先，我们需要兑换一些钱。We need some local cash for a taxi to the hotel.我们需要一些当地的现金来支付去酒店的出租车费。Okay, let’s go find an exchange office.好的，我们去找一家兑换所吧。I don’t think that’s a good idea.我不认为那是个好主意。The exchange rate(/reɪt/比率) is really high in the airport and so are the fees.(so am I我也一样)机场的汇率非常高，手续费也很高。The most economical(/ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk(ə)l/adj. 经济实惠的；节约的；简练的) way to obtain(/əbˈteɪn/得到,获得) British(/ˈbrɪtɪʃ/) pounds is to use our ATM card.获得英镑最经济实惠的方法是使用我们的ATM卡。Okay.好的。Excuse me, do you happen to(happen to 碰巧/恰巧 ) know where an ATM is in this area?打扰一下，请问您恰巧知道这附近哪里有自动取款机吗？It’s at the end of the corridor(/ˈkɔːrɪdɔːr/n. （建筑物或火车内的）通道，过道) near the gate door and men’s washroom.它就在走廊尽头，靠近登机口大门和男士洗手间的地方。It’s right in the corner.就在角落里。Thanks a lot.非常感谢。You’re welcome.不客气。 Hello, would you like a cab(/kæb/出租车,的士)?您好，需要出租车吗？Yes, we would.是的，我们需要。Where would you like to go?您想去哪里？To the Chamber Lane Hotel, do you know where it is?去张伯伦巷酒店，你知道它在哪里吗？I certainly do.我当然知道。It’s a popular hotel.那是一家热门酒店。I’ll take you there right away.我马上带您过去。Please put your luggage in the boot of the car.请把您的行李放在汽车的 boot 里。Boot?Boot？Oh, you mean the trunk?哦，你是说 trunk（后备箱）吗？Exactly, we call it boot in the UK.没错，在英国我们称之为 boot。Are you here on holiday?您是来度假的吗？Holiday, you mean vacation?Holiday？您是说 vacation（假期）吗？Yes.是的。That’s right, we’re here on vacation.是的，我们是来度假的。This is our first time here.这是我们第一次来这里。Well, welcome to our city.欢迎来到我们的城市。It’s a really nice time and for the year to visit.这是一年当中非常适合游览的好时节。There’s lots to see and do.这里有很多可看可做的事情。I really recommend checking out Oxford Street.我强烈推荐您去看看牛津街。It’s a popular shopping area.那是一个很受欢迎的购物区。Oh, that sounds interesting.哦，听起来很有意思。We do need to do some shopping, thanks for the tip.我们确实需要购物，谢谢您的建议（提示）。How long are you staying, may I ask?请问您打算待多久？We’ll be here for a week, so we should have plenty of time to see the most popular attractions.我们将在这里待一周，所以我们应该有足够的时间参观最热门的景点。Okay, here we are, it’s 20 pounds.好的，我们到了，是20英镑。Here you go.给您。Thanks and enjoy your stay.谢谢，祝您入住愉快。 Good morning, how can I help you?早上好，有什么可以帮您的吗？Good morning, we have a reservation under the name of Stuart.早上好，我们有一个以斯图尔特（Stewart）名字预订的房间。Let me check.我查一下。Yes, Stewart.是的，斯图尔特。A double room and a twin room for seven nights, bed and breakfast.一间双人房和一间双床房，共七晚，含床位和早餐。Is that right?对吗？That’s correct.是的。Could I see some ID please?请问我可以看一下您的身份证明吗？A passport or an identity card?护照或身份证都可以。Here you go.给您。Would you please fill in this registration form, sir?先生，请您填写一下这张入住登记表好吗？Sure.当然。What’s your favourite place in London if you don’t mind?如果您不介意的话，请问您在伦敦最喜欢的地方是哪里？Oh, it’s Covent Garden.哦，是科文特花园。It’s one of the best areas in London.那是伦敦最好的区域之一。There are many restaurants, alleys to explore and the best things to do.那里有很多餐厅、小巷可以探索，还有很多好玩的事情。How do we get there?我们怎么去那里？You can take a cab or use the tube.您可以打出租车或乘坐地铁（tube）。Taxis are pretty expensive in London, so we’d better take the subway.在伦敦出租车相当贵，所以我们最好乘地铁（subway）。Is the subway station far away from here?地铁站离这里远吗？As soon as you get out of the hotel, turn right.您一出酒店就向右转。Go straight ahead for five minutes.直走五分钟。Then you’ll see the underground station.然后您就会看到地铁站。You can’t miss it.您不会错过的。Okay, thanks a lot.好的，非常感谢。I’m done.我填好了。Here’s the form.这是表格。Thank you.谢谢。Your room includes breakfast in the morning.您的房间包括早晨的早餐。Breakfast is served between 7.30am and 10am in the restaurant in front of the reception.早餐在接待处前面的餐厅供应，时间是早上7点半到10点。On the last morning of your stay, you have to check out before 11am.在您入住的最后一个早上，您必须在上午11点前退房。Here’s your key.这是您的钥匙。It’s room 406 on the fourth floor.是四楼的406房间。Anything you need, please don’t hesitate to call our desk for help.您需要任何帮助，请随时致电我们的服务台。Enjoy your stay.祝您入住愉快。Thank you.谢谢您。Where is the elevator?电梯在哪里？The left is right there near the stairs.电梯就在楼梯旁边。When you get off the left, turn right.您出电梯后向右转。Your room is at the end of the corridor on the left-hand side.您的房间在走廊尽头的左手边。Do you need help with your bags?需要帮您搬行李吗？No, it’s okay, thanks.不用了，没关系，谢谢。 What are we going to do today?我们今天打算做什么？How about going to Covent Garden?去科文特花园怎么样？What’s that?那是什么？It’s London’s main theatre and entertainment area.那是伦敦主要的剧院和娱乐区。Are there markets too?那里也有市场吗？Yes, there are many markets and souvenir shops.是的，那里有很多市场和纪念品商店。Are there restaurants too?那里也有餐馆吗？I’m really hungry.我真的很饿了。Yes, there are some of the best restaurants in London.是的，那里有一些伦敦最好的餐馆。What are we waiting for then?那我们还在等什么？Let’s go.走吧。 Hello, I’m Harry.您好，我是哈里。I’ll be your waiter today.我将是今天为您服务的服务员。What can I get you to drink?您想喝点什么？I’ll have a lemonade, please.请给我一杯柠檬水。Me too.我也是。I’ll have a Coke.我要一杯可乐。And I’ll have a ginger beer.我要一杯姜汁啤酒。Okay, I’ll be right back with your drinks.好的，我马上把您的饮品拿回来。Are you ready to order?你们准备好点餐了吗？Yes, we are.是的，我们准备好了。I’ll have a Caesar salad and what’s an Alfredo sauce?我要一份凯撒沙拉，阿尔弗雷多酱（Alfredo sauce）是什么？A cream sauce, very rich, very good.一种奶油酱，非常浓郁，非常美味。Ooh, yummy.喔，好吃。I’ll try that.我要尝尝那个。I’ll try the house salad and the meatballs and spaghetti.我要一份招牌沙拉和肉丸意大利面。I’m going to have the steak medium and the soup to start.我点一份五分熟的牛排，再来一份汤作为开胃菜。What will you have, Philip?菲利普，你想要什么？I’m going to go for the cheese bomb burger and fries.我要点芝士炸弹汉堡和薯条。It’s so hard today.今天好热啊。I’d like to read an ice cream.我想吃个冰淇淋。Look, there’s an ice cream stand over there.看，那边有个冰淇淋摊。Let’s go.我们去吧。 Hi, how can I help you?嗨，有什么可以帮您的吗？Hi.嗨。What flavors of ice cream do you have?你们有什么口味的冰淇淋？We have all the basic flavors like chocolate, vanilla, coconut, banana and many more.我们有所有基本口味，像巧克力、香草、椰子、香蕉等等。Do you have strawberry ice cream?你们有草莓冰淇淋吗？Yes, we do.是的，有。How many scoops would you like?您想要几个球？I’d like one large scoop of strawberry and one small scoop of chocolate.我想要一大球草莓味和一小球巧克力味。Would you like any toppings?您想要加配料吗？Yes, I’d like chocolate sauce, please.是的，请给我加巧克力酱。Will that be all?就这些吗？Yes.是的。Okay, that will be five pounds.好的，一共是五英镑。Here you go.给您。Thank you.谢谢。What would you like to have?您想要什么？I would like three small scoops of strawberry, chocolate and vanilla ice cream with sprinkles, please.我想要三小球草莓、巧克力和香草冰淇淋，加点洒粉（sprinkles），谢谢。That will be five pounds.一共是五英镑。Thank you.谢谢。 I love Covent Garden.我太喜欢科文特花园了。There’s something magical about it.这里有一些神奇的魔力。It’s so colorful and it’s full of great places to eat and shop.它如此五彩缤纷，到处都是很棒的吃饭和购物场所。The street performers and musicians are really talented, aren’t they?街头艺人和音乐家们真有才华，不是吗？Yes, they are.是的，他们很有才华。It’s such a lovely atmosphere here.这里的氛围真是太可爱了。There are so many nice things in the souvenir market.纪念品市场里有好多漂亮的东西。Wow, look at this garden.哇，快看这个花园。It’s so cute.太可爱了。Excuse me, how much is this doll?打扰一下，这个玩偶多少钱？It’s 20 pounds.20英镑。I love it.我喜欢它。Can I buy it, Mom?妈妈，我可以买它吗？Of course.当然。And how much are those mugs with the British flag?那些带有英国国旗图案的马克杯多少钱？The big mugs are 10.25 and the small ones are 8.75.大马克杯是10.25英镑，小的是8.75英镑。Can I have two big mugs and one guard doll?我可以要两个大马克杯和一个卫兵玩偶吗？Here you are.给您。Anything else?还需要别的吗？How much is that white t-shirt over there?那边那件白色T恤多少钱？It’s 15 pounds.15英镑。Do you have it in large size?你们有大号的吗？Yes, of course.是的，当然有。Here you are.给您。What about this key chain with the London Underground logo?这个带有伦敦地铁标志的钥匙扣呢？How much is it?它多少钱？That’s two pounds.两英镑。Can I buy this for Grandpa?我可以买这个给爷爷吗？Sure, I think you would love it.当然，我想他会喜欢的。And this t-shirt is for Grandma.这件T恤是给奶奶的。Will that be all?就这些了吗？Yes, that’s all.是的，就这些了。It’s getting pretty late and I’m so tired.天色已经很晚了，我也很累了。I think we should go back to the hotel.我想我们应该回酒店了。I think so too.我也这么想。I wonder where the subway station is.我想知道地铁站在哪里。Excuse me, how do we get to the Underground station from here?打扰一下，我们从这里怎么去地铁站（Underground station）？Ah, it’s easy.哦，这很简单。Going on this street and turn right into Southampton Road.沿着这条街走，然后右转进入南安普顿路（Southampton Road）。OK, so turn right into Southampton Road.好的，右转进入南安普顿路。Yeah, then go along Southampton Road and go through Covent Garden Market.对，然后沿着南安普顿路走，穿过科文特花园市场。After that, go along James Street, Pass Floral Street.之后，沿着詹姆斯街（James Street）走，经过弗洛拉街（Floral Street）。You’ll see the station on the left.你会在左手边看到车站。How far away is it?它有多远？It will take you about 10 minutes.大约需要走10分钟。Thank you very much.非常感谢。Don’t mention it.不客气。 Good morning.早上好。How can I help you?有什么可以帮您的吗？Good morning.早上好。We’d like to book a bus tour for today.我们想预订今天的巴士观光。We’d like to see the top London landmarks.我们想看看伦敦最著名的地标。I recommend you our Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour.我向您推荐我们的随上随下（Hop-On Hop-Off）巴士观光。This tour lets you jump on and off so you can visit attractions,这个行程让您可以随时上下车，这样您可以参观景点、have lunch or go shopping,吃午餐或购物，could see famous attractions like Buckingham Palace,可以看到著名的景点，比如白金汉宫、famous Piccadilly Circus, the Tower of London, the Faga Square, Big Ben and many more.著名的皮卡迪利广场、伦敦塔、特拉法加广场、大本钟等等。That seems to be exactly what we need.这似乎正是我们需要的。How long does it take?这需要多长时间？The whole route takes about two hours and the bus departs from Waterloo.整个路线大约需要两个小时，巴士从滑铁卢（Waterloo）出发。And how much are the tickets?票价是多少？One ticket is 35 pounds and you can buy it from the driver.一张票是35英镑，您可以直接向司机购买。There is a discount for a family ticket which includes two adults and two children.还有家庭套票折扣，包括两名成人和两名儿童。That sounds good.听起来不错。Is there a guide on the bus?巴士上有没有导游？Yes, there is a live guide who gives you information about the place as your visit.是的，有一位现场导游，会在您游览时为您讲解关于这些地方的信息。That sounds amazing.听起来太棒了。We’re going to have a blast today.我们今天一定会玩得很尽兴。

entry.title: W Duolingo Test Interactive Speaking
entry.content: 一、个人经历类（基于纽约徒步经历）话题1：难忘的经历Questions What is the most unforgettable outdoor experience you have ever had? Who did you share this unforgettable experience with, and why was it so special to you? How did this experience change your attitude towards outdoor activities or daily life? Answers My unforgettable experience is hiking in New York with my brother. The summer snow mountains were beautiful. I felt excited when I reached the top. I shared it with my brother. I love nature and wanted to take photos. Hiking helped me forget work stress and relax my mind. It made me love outdoor activities more. I became braver and more confident. I also learned to slow down my busy life. 话题2：兴趣爱好Questions What is your favorite hobby and how did you develop this interest? How often do you engage in this hobby, and what do you usually do during the process? What benefits have you gained from sticking to this hobby? Answers My favorite hobby is hiking. The main reason is that my parents and brother took me when I was little. I hike when I have time, like weekends. I often go to mountains with my brother to enjoy nature and take photos. Hiking keeps me healthy. I don’t need to drive to stores and can buy things at home. When I go hiking, I use it to take photos and share the beautiful views with my friends at once. 话题3：数字产品体验（手机、app、智能设备）Questions What is your favorite digital product and why do you like it? What functions of this product do you use most every day? How do you use this product when you travel or hike? Answers My favorite digital product is my smartphone. It is very useful and helps me a lot in daily life. I use the note and chat functions most. I take study notes and talk to my friends every day. When I travel or hike, I use it to take photos and share the nice views with my friends at once. 话题4：社交媒体的使用Questions How do you use social media to communicate with your friends? What benefits do you get from keeping in touch with American friends? How do you share your hiking activities with friends on social media? Answers I use social media to chat and have video calls with my friends. It is easy and fast to talk to them. It helps me make friends with American people. We talk often and our friendship becomes stronger. I take photos when I go hiking, then share them on social media. My friends can see the beautiful views too. 六、文化与社会类（核心素材：中西节日与跨文化交流）话题1：节日与文化传统Questions What is your favorite traditional festival in China, and how do you celebrate it? What is the most important festival in the US that you know? What similarities do you find between Chinese and Western festivals? Answers My favorite Chinese festival is the Spring Festival. I usually have a big family dinner with my relatives, watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV and receive lucky red packets from my parents. Christmas is the most important festival in the US. People buy gifts for each other and stay with family. Both are family festivals. People get together, have fun and share love with their family and friends. 话题2：跨文化交流Questions How did you make friends with your American friends? What activities did you do together with your American friends? How did this communication change your understanding of different cultures? Answers I made friends with them at Christmas. We bought gifts for each other and talked a lot. We went hiking together in New York. We used different languages to praise the beautiful snow mountains. It made me know more about different countries. I can talk to people from other places easily now. 话题3：文化差异带来的体验Questions What interesting experience did you have because of cultural differences? How did you feel when you celebrated Christmas with American friends? What is the best way to learn about different cultures in your opinion? Answers I celebrated Christmas with American friends. We gave gifts to each other and it was a new experience. I felt very happy. It was different from Chinese festivals but it was warm and interesting. I think watching movies and reading books are the best ways. They can tell us a lot about different cultures. 七、最喜欢的…（核心素材：个人偏好）话题1：最喜欢的电影Questions What is your favorite movie and what is it about? Why do you like this movie so much? Do you want to experience the things in this movie? Answers My favorite movie is Harry Potter. It is about a very amazing magic world with interesting stories. I like it because the magic world in the movie is very wonderful and attractive to me. Yes, I want to experience the magic life like the characters in the movie very much. 话题2：最喜欢的书Questions What is your favorite book and who is its author? What is the main idea of this book? What inspirations do you get from this book? Answers My favorite book is The Little Prince. Its author is Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. The main idea is that we should keep childlike imagination and curiosity about the world. It inspires me to look at the world with a child’s eyes and keep my curiosity all the time. 话题3：最喜欢的歌Questions What is your favorite song and who sings it? Why do you like this song so much? Do you listen to this song in any specific situations? Answers My favorite song is My Heart Will Go On. It is sung by Celine Dion, a great singer. I like it because its melody is very nice and beautiful. It makes me feel relaxed when I listen to it. Yes, I listen to it when I drive to work. It makes my trip to the office more enjoyable. 话题4：最喜欢的食物Questions What is your favorite food and what flavor is it? Why do you like this food more than other foods? Where do you usually eat this food? Answers My favorite food is beef patties. It has a spicy flavor that I like very much. I like it because I love beef and I also like to eat spicy food a lot. I usually eat it in a small restaurant near my home. The people there cook it very well. 话题5：最喜欢的水果Questions What is your favorite fruit and what does it taste like? When is the best season to eat this fruit? Why do you like this fruit so much? Answers My favorite fruit is watermelon. It tastes very sweet and juicy, and it is very crisp. The best season to eat watermelon is summer. We can buy it easily in markets at that time. I like it because it is sweet and juicy. It can also quench my thirst in the hot summer. 话题6：最喜欢的季节Questions What is your favorite season and what is the weather like? What outdoor activities do you like to do in this season? Why do you like this season more than others? Answers My favorite season is summer. The weather is sunny and hot, and there is a lot of bright sunshine. I like to swim outdoors and go hiking in summer. The summer snow mountains in New York are beautiful. I like it because there is a lot of sunshine and I can do many outdoor activities that I love. 话题7：最喜欢的科目Questions What is your favorite subject and why do you like it? Is this subject related to your job? How do you help your students learn this subject well? Answers My favorite subject is math. I like it because this subject is very interesting and fun to learn. Yes, it is. I am a math teacher and I teach little kids math every day in my school. I make fun games and activities. I try my best to make math lessons interesting for my students. 一、个人经历类（基于纽约徒步经历） The most unforgettable experience is hiking in New York with my brother in summer. The snowy mountains there were very wonderful. It was special because I took nice photos, forgot my busy work and slowed down my life pace. When I reached the top of the mountain, I felt excited and more relaxed, with the cool wind blowing against my face. It made me more confident and braver. I began to love outdoor activities more than before. I like it because I can explore nature, keep healthy and take beautiful photos. When I was a kid, I usually hiked with my parents and brother. It helps me forget my busy work, clear my mind and become a more confident and braver person. My best trip is hiking in New York with my brother in summer. When I was young, I often went hiking with my parents and brother. Hiking with family is fun and it can make us closer to each other. 二、日常生活类（基于日常作息与生活习惯） I get up early every day and go running first. Running makes me healthy and full of energy for the day. I drive to the downtown for work. My favorite food is Chinese food. I usually eat it in a small restaurant near my office at lunchtime. I like spicy food now. It is cheap and very tasty, especially the fried dishes. When I was a child, I liked to eat sweet food, but now I prefer spicy food. I prefer online shopping. The main reason is that it’s more convenient for me, and another reason is that I can choose a wider range of products. It can save me a lot of time. I don’t need to drive to stores and there are more things to choose. It is important because exercise can keep me healthy and make me more energetic every day. I use my computer and phone to take notes and make plans. I repeat practicing English every day. I make a clear plan every day. I do housework first, then practice English and have enough time to rest. 三、教育与学习类（核心素材：英语老师与学习经历） The best method is taking notes on computer and phone and repeating practice. My English teacher taught me this. It also made me closer to my classmates and we became good friends.I even study when I walk on the road. It can save me a lot of time. It also helps me remember things well and improve my English quickly. My English teacher helped me a lot when I learned English. He is very helpful and kind. He taught me how to do homework well and use homework to improve English. The most unforgettable activity is joining the English group in my school. We met every week to practice our English skills. It made my English better. He taught me good learning methods. 四、工作与职业类（核心素材：数学老师职业经历） I’m a math teacher. I teach young children at a school. I work about four hours a day. My main responsibility is teaching students and checking their homework after class. The most challenging part is making kids love math. I need to think of fun ways to teach them. Teamwork helps us make better plans. Our students can learn math better with our interesting lessons. I met a problem that some students didn’t like math. I felt worried and wanted to help them. We made fun games and activities to make math lessons more interesting. Fun lessons can help students learn math better and faster. It helped me learn how to communicate with kids. I make a clear plan every day. I teach in the day, correct homework after class and have time for my life. I travel to see nature in summer vacation. I spend a lot of time with my family in winter vacation. Making a good plan is very important. It helps me balance work and life and not feel too tired. I go hiking with my brother on weekends. It helps me forget work stress and relax my mind. When I go back to work, I am in a good state. 五、科技相关（核心素材：智能手机使用经历） I use my smartphone most for study. I take notes and practice English with it every day. It changes my learning a lot. I can study even when I walk on the road, so I have more study time. It is better than traditional ways. It saves time and I can study anywhere and anytime I want. My smartphone changes my shopping and communication. I shop online and talk to friends easily now. The biggest convenience is saving time. I don’t need to drive to stores and can buy things at home. When I go hiking, I use my phone to take photos and share the wonderful scenery with my friends at once. It makes the trip more fun. I use the note and chat functions most. I take study notes and talk to my friends every day. I use social media to chat and have video calls with my friends. It is easy and fast to talk to them. 六、文化与社会类（核心素材：中西节日与跨文化交流） My favorite Chinese festival is the Spring Festival. I usually have a big family dinner with my relatives, watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV and receive lucky red packets from my parents. Christmas is the most important festival in the US. People buy gifts for each other and stay with family. Both are family festivals. People get together, have fun and share love with their family and friends We bought gifts for each other and talked a lot. We went hiking together in New York. We used different languages to praise the beautiful snow mountains. We gave gifts to each other and it was a new experience. I felt very happy. It was different from Chinese festivals but it was warm and interesting. I think watching movies and reading books are the best ways. They can tell us a lot about different cultures.

entry.title: W daily english Notes
entry.content: hexo s… 50 句高频超市购物英语实用清单A. 寻找商品 (Asking for Items) Where can I find the milk/frozen shrimp?(请问我在哪里可以找到牛奶/冷冻虾？) What aisle (/aɪl/ 货架通道) is the frozen seafood in?(冷冻海鲜在哪个通道？) I’m looking for tomatoes/the produce (/ˈprɒdjuːs/ 农产品) section(/ˈsekʃ(ə)n/ 区域).(我正在找西红柿/农产品区。) Which aisle is the bread in?(面包在哪个货架（通道）？) Could you tell me where the frozen meals are?(您能告诉我冷冻食品在哪里吗？) Is the pasta on this shelf?(意大利面在这个架子上吗？) Where are the spices and condiments (/ˈkɒndɪmənts/ 调味品)?(香料和调味品在哪里？) I need help finding the cereal.(我需要帮助寻找麦片。) Could you show me the way to the detergent (/dɪˈtɜːrdʒənt/ 洗涤剂)?(您能带我去洗涤剂区吗？) B. 关于商品细节 (About Products & Details) Is this fruit ripe?(这个水果熟了吗？) How much does this cost per pound?(这个一磅多少钱？) What is the expiry (/ɪkˈspaɪəri/ 到期, 期满) date on this yogurt?(这盒酸奶的保质期是多久？) Is this bread freshly baked?(这个面包是新鲜出炉的吗？) Do you have a smaller portion (/ˈpɔːrʃn/ 一部分, 一份)?(你们有小份一点的吗？) Are there any items on sale (/seɪl/ 销售, 特价)?(有什么商品在打折（特价）吗？) Is this beef grass-fed?(这个牛肉是草饲的吗？) Where is the debit (/ˈdebɪt/ 借方, 扣款) card machine?(借记卡机（刷卡机）在哪里？) Does this contain any allergens (/ˈælərdʒənz/ 过敏原)?(这个含有任何过敏原吗？) Could I get a small bag of apples?(我能拿一小袋苹果吗？) C. 生鲜区/服务台 (Deli/Meat/Service Counter) I’d like half a pound of ham, please. (请给我半磅火腿。) Can you slice this cheese thinly?(您能把这个奶酪切薄一点吗？) What’s the leanest (/ˈliːnɪst/ 最瘦的, 最精的) cut of chicken you have?(你们最精（瘦）的鸡肉是哪一块？) I need one pound of ground beef.(我需要一磅绞肉。) Can I sample this before I buy it?(我买之前可以尝一下吗？) Could you wrap this separately (/ˈseprətli/ 分开地, 个别地)?(您可以把这个分开包起来吗？) Do you have any fresh salmon today?(你们今天有新鲜的鲑鱼吗？) What kind of dressing (/ˈdresɪŋ/ 沙拉酱, 调料) do you recommend?(您推荐哪种沙拉酱？) Can I place a special order (/ˈɔːrdər/ 订单, 定制)?(我可以下特殊订单（定制）吗？) How long will this stay fresh?(这个能保持新鲜多久？) D. 购物车与援助 (Cart & Assistance) Where are the shopping carts?(购物车在哪里？) Do you have a small basket?(你们有小购物篮吗？) Could you help me reach that item on the top shelf?(您能帮我拿到顶层货架上的东西吗？) Where is the restroom?(请问洗手间在哪里？) Excuse me, is there a store employee nearby?(打扰一下，附近有店员吗？) My cart wheel is stuck (/stʌk/ 卡住的, 动不了的).(我的购物车轮子卡住了。) Do you offer home delivery (/dɪˈlɪvəri/ 递送, 送货)?(你们提供送货服务吗？) Is there a limit (/ˈlɪmɪt/ 限制, 限额) on this item?(这个商品有限购吗？) Can I leave my cart here for a minute?(我可以把购物车在这里放一会儿吗？) Where is the customer service desk (/desk/ 服务台, 办公桌)?(顾客服务台在哪里？) E. 结账区 (At the Checkout) Where is the shortest line?(哪条队伍（结账通道）最短？) Do you take credit cards?(你们收信用卡吗？) Can I get cash back with this transaction (/trænˈzækʃn/ 交易)?(这笔交易我可以拿现金返还（提现）吗？) Could you please scan this again?(您能再扫一下这个商品吗？) I have a coupon for this.(我有这个商品的优惠券。) Please use paper bags instead of plastic.(请用纸袋代替塑料袋。) Could you void (/vɔɪd/ 使无效, 取消) this item? I changed my mind.(您能取消这个商品吗？我改变主意了。) Could I get a receipt, please?(请给我一张收据。) How much is the total?(总共多少钱？) I need to return this item.(我需要退货。)
